name: 48307 · Rochester Hls, MI
findings: ZIP 48307 (Rochester Hls) has 140 nonprofit organizations. 50 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48307 (Rochester Hls) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 48307 (Rochester Hls) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).
